subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido was a derro who manifested a macabre shrine of bones and skeletons, claimed divine authority over faithful followers, and attacked with manic violence before being slain by Daz's magic missiles.
source_quote: Your divine mission is now over.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is an arcane spellcaster who recognized Buppido’s threat, cast Fairie Fire to mark skeletons for advantage, and ultimately killed Buppido with Magic Missile, ending the battle.
source_quote: Magic missiles," he thinks, visualizing the shimmering darts.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf warrior who charged into combat against Buppido’s skeletons, landed a solid blow on one, and later expressed sorrow over Buppido’s death despite the violence.
source_quote: He was a crazy one, but he was our crazy one.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a tactician who used darkness to disorient Buppido’s undead minions, creating opportunity for allies, and supported Grygum’s plan by disrupting visibility.
source_quote: Zalthir plunges the area into darkness.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a cleric of Bahamut who prepared to turn undead against Buppido’s skeletons, held his action due to Zalthir’s darkness, and later performed a ritual for Buppido’s soul.
source_quote: And as he prepares to pray for Buppido’s soul, a ghostly head pops up.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek is the ghostly Svirfneblin whose name is derived from an actor his mother named him after, causing familial shame and tension, and who was once a merchant and friend of Buppido.
source_quote: My mother named me after an actor.

subject: Svirfneblin
fact: The Svirfneblin (deep gnomes) traditionally name themselves after objects or sounds associated with them, often using onomatopoeia, as evidenced by Pelek’s naming convention.
source_quote: The Gnomes tend to name themselves after things and that many of their names are onomatopoeia of the sounds of those things.

subject: skeletons
fact: A cluster of animated skeletons served Buppido as minions, were marked by Fairie Fire, and were later destroyed by Grygum’s Turn Undead after being disoriented by Zalthir’s darkness.
source_quote: Three skeletons are marked, and an ethereal glow surrounds them.

subject: hooked spear
fact: Buppido wielded a hooked spear in his final charge against Thorin, but his attack was wild and ineffective, driven by fury rather than skill.
source_quote: Buppido rushes at Thorin with a hooked spear but misses wildly.

subject: crossbow
fact: One of Buppido’s skeletons used a crossbow to strike Grygum during the chaos of Zalthir’s darkness, inflicting a visible injury.
source_quote: One skeleton, however, manages to take a shot at Grygum with its crossbow.

subject: caves
fact: The battle occurred in a cave system that previously housed Buppido’s shrine of bones and skeletons, now littered with the remains of the derro and his undead servants.
source_quote: The blood-spattered remains of Buppido lie scattered amongst the bones that made up the crazed Derro’s hideout.

subject: turn undead
fact: Grygum successfully cast Turn Undead against Buppido’s skeleton minions, overwhelming them with divine power and turning the battle into a slaughter.
source_quote: The cleric’s words of power overwhelm the skeletal minions of Buppido.

subject: magic missiles
fact: Daz cast Magic Missile, three unerring bolts of arcane force that struck Buppido directly, killing him instantly and ending the threat.
source_quote: Three bolts of magical force streak through the air, each unerringly finding its mark on Buppido.

subject: Pelek's origin
fact: Pelek’s name and lineage are shrouded in familial shame and uncertainty, stemming from his mother naming him after an actor, and his father’s jealousy — a mystery that may connect to deeper cultural or magical roots.
source_quote: There was always this doubt about the origin of the name and my lineage, which created a lot of friction in my family.

subject: session 19
fact: Session 19 occurred on the 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493, during which Buppido was slain and Pelek the ghostly Svirfneblin emerged.
source_quote:
Session 19
## 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: actor namesake
fact: Pelek was named after an actor, an unusual practice among Svirfneblin, raising questions about cultural influence, hidden ancestry, or magical legacy tied to performance or illusion.
source_quote: My mother named me after an actor.
